## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:三份 pm-dispatch 参考文件里五处复审遗留的措辞小问题,全部原地改,行数不变(63/104/82)。
- 为什么改:PR #33731 复审记下的五个 nit;不改会让席位读错 nit 去向、落地前检是否认后续记录、24h 流量的时点和 ADR/技能文本卡按什么单位立。
- 风险与回滚:只动三行规则文字的措辞,无代码、门禁或棘轮上限变化;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`references/triage-duties.md` 第 74 行(谁立卡不变,只补单位:每个实施 PR 一张);`references/contract-review.md` 第 51 行;第 41-42 行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期全部 ✓,三个文件行数等于上限且无超过 120 字节的行。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S)。

## What changes

Five nits in six in-place line edits, 0 net lines (+6 / -6), every touched line at or under 120 bytes. Each item is the card's, verbatim line re-read on `origin/main` 895783a1.

- **N2, `contract-review.md` L41-42.** The nit route now points at the filing rule: 「转后续卡(`filing-gate.md`)」. Bytes paid in the same bullet: 「同一复核者」 to 「原复核者」 (the spelling `lanes/review.md` already uses for the delta reviewer), 「delta 复核修复」 to 「delta 复核」, the repeated subject 「nit 」 after 「仅 nit 即终轮,」 dropped, and 「(无碍正确性与契约)」 to 「(无碍正确与契约)」, which lets 「由」 move up to L41. 「只改散文面」 is kept. 「PR 后续卡」 lost its 「PR」: the card title lives in `filing-gate.md` now pointed at.
- **N5, `filing-gate.md` L35.** 「接受偏差」 back to 「接受的偏差」, the spelling of `contract-review.md` L42 and of the ACCEPT checklist in `SKILL.md` (核对六项 … 接受的偏差). The title code span is now separated from 「逐项勾」 by a space. Paid in place: the three 「、」 inside the parenthesis became `/` (the file's own sub-list separator, as in 「文案/文档」).
- **N6, `contract-review.md` L51.** Pre-check ① now reads 「现 head 末条同形达档 PASS,无未闭前两级」: the LATEST record on the head governs, and a finding it records as closed no longer counts. That is what the queue guard does (`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: a later same-head delta record that closes the findings clears; one that raises a new should-fix refuses though an older clean PASS stands). Paid in place: 「两条」 (the ① ② that follow count them) and 「在案」 (「末条」 takes its place).
- **N3, `triage-duties.md` L16.** 「每 3 小时」 now names its clock: 「UTC 3 倍数时的轮次记录」, the rounds whose UTC hour is divisible by 3. That keeps the 3-hour cadence and judges by fire time, as L9 of the same file does for tiers (never by a counter). Paid in place: the list's three 「、」 became `,`.
- **N4, `triage-duties.md` L74.** Now 「ADR/技能文本携带注记 ⛔ 不挂实施卡,每实施 PR 一 `domain:skills` 卡;ADR 由落地席合并后立。」 Who files stays as on `main`: the skills-text card is triage's at first touch (`lanes/skills.md` 「分诊首触即立本域子卡」), the ADR card the landing seat's after the merge (`execution-duties.md`). Only the unit is added: one card per implementation PR, for both halves. The PR need not exist yet; the card is named by the PR it will follow.

## Tests

No test changes; no script, workflow or package is touched.

## Acceptance notes

- **Review round 1 (record 6896322254, FAIL with M1):** M1 fixed by the record's fix (a), the seat's ruling: L74 keeps `main`'s actors and only gains the per-PR unit for both halves. Moving the skills-text card's filer would need a decision card, which this nit card does not carry. Nits Na (restore 「只」) and Nb (name the clock in L16) taken, both in place.
- **N2 compression:** none of the dropped words carries a rule. 「修复」: the delta review is of the fix by definition (`lanes/review.md` 「delta 复审归原复核者」). 「正确性」 to 「正确」 keeps the nit definition's meaning (no harm to correctness or contract).
- `grep` over `scripts/`, `.claude/`, `.github/`, `docs/` and `AGENTS.md` for every replaced phrase (「无前两级」, 「复核修复」, 「同一复核者」, 「PR 后续卡」, 「接受偏差」, 「逐项勾」, 「每 3 小时」, 「只改散文面」, 「前检两条」) finds no pin outside the three files.
- Serial: #33716 and #33601 also edit `contract-review.md` and wait for this PR.
